slot.brief: Particle moving in a straight line; find angular momentum about a fixed off-line point using r × p magnitude

stem: A particle of mass $2\ \text{kg}$ is at $(8,6)\ \text{m}$ relative to the origin and moves at $10\ \text{m s}^{-1}$ in the direction $3\hat{i}+4\hat{j}$. The magnitude of its angular momentum about the origin is:

verdicts.working: The unit direction is (3/5, 4/5), so v = (6, 8) m/s. Thus |L| = |r × mv| = |8·16 − 6·12| = 56 kg·m²·s⁻¹.

working:
$\vec{v}=10\left(\dfrac{3}{5}\hat{i}+\dfrac{4}{5}\hat{j}\right)=(6\hat{i}+8\hat{j})\ \text{m s}^{-1}$
$L=|x p_y-y p_x|=2|8(8)-6(6)|=56\ \text{kg m}^2\text{s}^{-1}$

Independent check: The unit direction is (3/5, 4/5), so v = (6, 8) m/s. Thus |L| = |r × mv| = |8·16 − 6·12| = 56 kg·m²·s⁻¹.
